_about: Business metrics. Expressions are copied from the approved KPI view definitions (gold/procurement_kpis/kpi_queries.py) or from documented safe aggregation rules. ambiguity_group links metrics a user could mean by the same words; a question matching several metrics of one group is returned for clarification instead of being guessed.

metrics.name: Contract awards
metrics.description: Number of signed contract awards (DS00005 contracts, FY2020+). A contract, not a notice.

metrics.name: Contract-award announcement notices
metrics.description: Number of published Contract Award notices (award records in DS00979). A notice, not a contract; links to contracts exist only for 184 projects.
caveats: Award announcements are published after signing (median 157 days) and are not contracts.

metrics.name: Contract award value (US$)
metrics.description: Exact sum of contract amounts at contract grain (sum of published supplier lines). Covers all financiers of each contract.
caveats: Not an IBRD/IDA amount; never added to financing commitments.

metrics.name: IBRD/IDA original principal (US$ as published)
metrics.description: Sum of original principal of IBRD loans and IDA credits, per lender.
metrics.grain_note: sum at instrument grain, per lender
metrics.source: SILVER_RELATIONSHIP_REPORT.md (sum original_principal_amount_usd per lender; never mix with contract amounts)
caveats: US$ equivalents are not on one consistent exchange-rate basis.

metrics.name: Project current total commitment (US$ snapshot)
metrics.description: Current total commitment of projects as of the 2026-10-21 projects snapshot.
caveats: Current, not original; differs from IBRD/IDA principal for 472 of 1,597 projects.

metrics.name: Procurement notices
metrics.description: Number of published procurement notices of all classes.
metrics.grain_note: notice grain (identical-metadata rows counted as published)

metrics.name: Tender invitation notices (IFB)
metrics.description: Number of Invitation for Bids notices (actual tender notices).
caveats: A tender notice is not a contract; not every tender can be linked to a signed contract.

metrics.name: Solicitation notices (IFB, IFP, REOI)
metrics.description: Number of notices with a response deadline: Invitation for Bids, Invitation for Prequalification and Request for Expression of Interest.

metrics.name: Prior-review share of contracts
metrics.description: prior_review_contracts / (prior_review_contracts + post_review_contracts); contracts with unknown review type are excluded.
metrics.grain_note: computed at display time from additive counts

metrics.name: Share of contracts with other-country suppliers
metrics.grain_note: computed at display time from additive counts

metrics.name: Median published response window (days)
metrics.description: Discrete median of published response windows (1-180 days) for eligible solicitations.
metrics.grain_note: one grouping_level at a time; not additive
caveats: Published windows, NOT verified tender durations.

metrics.name: IBRD/IDA financing instruments
metrics.description: Number of IBRD loans and IDA credits/grants, by lender.

metrics.name: Contracts with an evidence-supported award-notice link
metrics.description: Contracts whose award_notice_link_status is unambiguous or ambiguous, among covered contracts.
caveats: Links exist only for the 184 API-covered projects; no_link_found does not prove there is no notice.
